module.spatialaudio.desc: 定位投屏、后台应用与游戏声音，估算房间声学、材质反射及遮挡，并显示声线
Position projection, background app, and game audio; estimate room acoustics, material reflections, and occlusion, and display sound rays
setting.spatialaudio.muteOriginal.hint: 默认开启。具备独立虚拟输出时自动配置所选应用路由，确认活动音频会话隔离后才采集。缺少设备时请使用环境配置安装；未核验前保留原音。关闭隔离会使用普通采集，可能叠音。

Enabled by default. With an independent virtual output, routes the selected app automatically and captures only after its active audio session is confirmed isolated. If the device is missing, use environment setup to install it. Until verified, the original audio stays unchanged. Disabling isolation uses ordinary capture and may duplicate audio.
setting.spatialaudio.update.hint: 缓存模式默认每 0.4 秒更新，首批声线逐步显示。遮挡与距离另行快速更新。实时模式提高采样频率；手动模式在重新采样或参数改变时更新。

Cached mode updates every 0.4 seconds by default and displays initial rays progressively. Occlusion and distance update separately at a faster rate. Real-time mode probes more frequently; manual mode updates on rebake or parameter changes.
ui.spatial.subtitle: 房间声学 · 材质吸收与反射 · 投屏、后台及游戏声音定位
Room acoustics · Material absorption and reflections · Projection, background, and game audio
ui.spatial.noCast: 尚未选择可用的声音来源应用
No available audio source app selected
ui.spatial.waitingProbe: 等待首次房间声学采样
Waiting for the first room probe
ui.spatial.metrics: 估算体积 {0} m³ · 围合度 {1}% · RT60 {2}s · 回声延迟 {3}ms
Est. volume {0} m³ · Enclosure {1}% · RT60 {2}s · Echo delay {3}ms
ui.spatial.captureHint: 仅采集所选投屏应用及其子进程。默认隔离模式会使用独立虚拟输出，并在核验活动会话路由后采集。缺少设备请打开环境配置；普通采集模式可能同时播放原音。

Captures only the selected app and its child processes. Default isolation uses an independent virtual output and captures after verifying the active session route. Open environment setup if the device is missing. Ordinary capture may also play the original audio.
ui.spatial.cacheHint: 默认每 0.4 秒更新缓存，仅读取已加载区块，首批声线不再等待整轮完成。实际完成速度受采样数量、反射次数和每刻预算影响；声音连续播放。开放空间及过大的房间会削弱回声。

The cache updates every 0.4 seconds using loaded chunks; initial rays appear before the full pass finishes. Completion speed depends on ray count, reflections, and per-tick budget. Playback stays continuous; open or very large spaces weaken echoes.
ui.spatial.approximation: 方块声学与房间参数为游戏近似，并非实测物理模拟。声线表示采样传播路径，不代表每一条路径都有可听声音。关闭后恢复本功能修改的音效。

Block acoustics and room parameters are game approximations, not measured physical simulation. Rays show sampled propagation paths, not guaranteed audible paths. Disabling restores the audio effects changed by this feature.
ui.spatial.materialHint: 按方块标签与类型归类；未匹配方块采用石材近似。吸收系数越高，反射能量越少；散射越高，反射越分散。可用左侧倍率整体调整。
Grouped by block tags and type; unmatched blocks use a stone approximation. Higher absorption reduces reflected energy; higher scattering spreads reflections. Adjust global scales on the left.

ui.spatial.routingHint: 默认隔离模式会把所选应用路由到独立虚拟输出，确认活动音频会话已隔离后才采集。缺少设备时可打开环境配置下载并安装 VB-CABLE，安装需管理员权限，可能需重启；不会自动重启。Minecraft 保持耳机／扬声器输出，关闭 Windows「侦听此设备」。普通采集模式可能叠音。

Default isolation routes the selected app to an independent virtual output and captures only after confirming its active session is isolated. If the device is missing, environment setup can download and install VB-CABLE. Installation needs administrator access and may need a manual restart; no automatic restart occurs. Keep Minecraft on headphones or speakers and Windows “Listen to this device” off. Ordinary capture may duplicate audio.

ui.spatial.env.title: 空间音频环境
Spatial audio environment
ui.spatial.env.subtitle: 检测独立输出设备并配置所选声音应用；系统驱动操作需确认
Check independent output devices and configure the audio source app; driver actions require confirmation
ui.spatial.env.source: 要配置的声音来源应用
ui.spatial.env.sourceHint: 投屏模式可切换已添加的投屏；后台声音模式可选择独立应用。一键配置只修改所选应用的输出路由，游戏输出保持耳机或扬声器。
Cycle added screens in projection mode, or choose an independent app in background mode. One-click setup changes only the selected app’s output route; keep game audio on headphones or speakers.

ui.spatial.env.prerequisitesMissing: 条件未满足或尚未检测

ui.spatial.env.routeUnconfirmed: 尚未确认活动音频会话路由
Active audio session route not confirmed
ui.spatial.env.configureHint: 缺少驱动时，一键配置会先下载官方安装包，再请求管理员安装；已有驱动时仅配置所选应用。恢复会暂停自动路由，直至再次明确配置或重连。

If the driver is missing, setup downloads the official package and requests administrator installation. With the driver present, only the selected app is routed. Restoration pauses automatic routing until you explicitly configure or reconnect again.
ui.spatial.env.driverHint: 安装和卸载只针对 VB-CABLE，并会打开 Windows 管理员确认。可能需要手动重启；不会自动重启电脑，也不自动操作其他音频设备。

Installation and removal target only VB-CABLE and open Windows administrator confirmation. A manual restart may be needed; the computer is not restarted automatically and other audio devices are not automatically modified.
ui.spatial.env.playbackHint: 让源应用输出到独立、未监听的虚拟设备；Minecraft 保持耳机或扬声器。Windows 的「侦听此设备」会再次播放原音，请保持关闭。
Route the source app to an independent virtual device without monitoring; keep Minecraft on headphones or speakers. Windows “Listen to this device” plays the original again and should remain off.
ui.spatial.env.resultHint: 检测通过表示设备与路由条件具备；请播放所选应用，确认空间处理及关闭功能后的声音恢复。
Passing checks confirms device and routing prerequisites; play the selected app to verify spatial processing and audio restoration after disabling.
ui.spatial.env.busy: 操作进行中，请等待系统确认或完成检测
Operation in progress; wait for system confirmation or checks
ui.spatial.env.explicitOnly: 安装与删除仅在明确确认后执行
Installation and removal run only after explicit confirmation
ui.spatial.env.confirm.title: 确认系统音频操作
Confirm system audio action
ui.spatial.env.confirm.configure: 为「{0}」配置独立音频路由。缺少 VB-CABLE 时会下载官方包并请求管理员安装系统音频驱动，可能需要手动重启。已有驱动时只修改该应用路由。是否继续？

Set up an independent audio route for “{0}”. If VB-CABLE is missing, the official package is downloaded and administrator installation of the audio driver is requested. A manual restart may be needed. Otherwise only this app’s route changes. Continue?
ui.spatial.env.confirm.install: 下载官方 VB-CABLE 安装包，并请求管理员安装系统音频驱动。Windows 会显示确认窗口，可能需要手动重启。此按钮不安装其他音频设备。是否继续？

Download the official VB-CABLE package and request administrator installation of its audio driver. Windows shows a confirmation prompt; a manual restart may be needed. This button installs no other audio devices. Continue?
ui.spatial.env.confirm.uninstall: 先恢复保存的应用路由，再请求管理员卸载 VB-CABLE。使用此虚拟设备的应用会失去该输出，可能需要手动重启。只卸载 VB-CABLE，不删除其他音频驱动。是否继续？

Restore saved app routes, then request administrator removal of VB-CABLE. Apps using this virtual device lose that output, and a manual restart may be needed. Only VB-CABLE is removed; other audio drivers are kept. Continue?
